status: local exploratory specification before calibration and validation; no external preregistration
memory_resource: Total fresh-child process peak resident memory in bytes, including import and warm-up
cpu_resource: Child user plus system CPU seconds for input construction, computation, and verification, excluding import and warm-up
observation_policy: Run every declared size in randomized order using fresh children; retain all outcomes; largest completed size is zero if none and upper-censored if the grid maximum completes
primary_endpoint: Largest-completed-size survival profile on the fixed size grid, by assigned budget condition
main_forecast: Replay whole paired calibration cost profiles under frozen budget pairs
decision_rule: Freeze calibration-based nominal predictive error tolerances before validation; report every full-profile error and comparator difference, without inferring universal law or calibrated population-level coverage
interpretation: Actual measured computation under experimentally assigned cooperative acceptance quotas; evaluates prospective cost-model transfer and observation machinery, not spontaneous neutral allocation
